info.name: VisibilityOS AI Answer Study Dataset
info.description:
# VisibilityOS AI Answer Study Dataset

VisibilityOS by PodPitch compared repeated answers to the same buying questions across eight AI engine views. This collection retrieves the two version 1.0.0 CSV files and checks their published totals.

Run **Get engine-view results** for the matched comparisons and brand-presence changes by view. Run **Get pooled outcomes** for the gains, losses, unchanged observations, and official-link changes across the whole sample.

The public files contain aggregate counts. Brand presence changed in 82 of 817 matched comparisons (10.0%). An official link appeared or disappeared in 79 comparisons (9.7%). The two measures can overlap. View-level rates use each view's own comparison count.

- [VisibilityOS by PodPitch](https://visibilityos.co/)
- [Published study and measurement method](https://visibilityos.co/research/ai-answer-visibility)
- [Dataset definitions and release files](https://podpitch.github.io/visibilityos-audit-template/study/dataset/)

The requests fetch public, versioned files and require no account, API key, or environment.
